previousRule: The mixed cart repeated current curtain calculations, fabric and stock checks and cushion facts and rules inside one read-only review request, then ran Roman combined stock after the mixed review. Checkout separately revalidated all authorities.
newRule: One cart review may reuse its own freshly checked curtain calculations, fabric availability, delivery, cushion facts and cushion rules for mixed preparation. Combined curtain and cushion stock and combined Roman stock remain mandatory, and Roman stock may run alongside mixed preparation. Checkout still performs a separate fresh review before any order write.
reason: Production timing showed a 9.3-second four-product review, including a 3.7-second duplicate curtain preparation. Same-request reuse removes redundant supplier reads without accepting client-provided prices or stock and keeps every combined shortage check.
ownerApprovedDecision: The owner requested a faster and reliable checkout. This protected regression-test and policy-record change requires Nylon1's exact-current-head PR comment before merge or deployment; this record does not grant approval.
